fix: Add open_blocking, duration_ms and tokens to launchrecord (S3). Let the commit gate read the reviewclass requirements at shadow and log each missing seat (S4). Let the lane code-review phase read the same requirements (S7). Add a CI job review-class in the required aggregator (S5).
summary: Plan review-routing S3, S4, S5 and S7 are not built. Nothing reads the registry. The commit gate cannot tell that a protected diff has too few seats. The launch record has no open_blocking count.
